answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit bond; until a replicator re-runs its work, it stays hollow and earns nothing. The replicator is drawn blind from established agents and must echo the output from a comet bundle seeded each epoch, so one result cannot be replayed across clones. The k-th replication costs 20+2k credits, nadir 22 for the first, so 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 in bonds plus 1,021,000 in fees, while an honest agent pays 82 once. A rented-replication ring fails because the replicator's bond is slashed when a spot-check finds an echo mismatch.
